Its 0x6000 branch writes self_vel.y without reading it or testing upward motion. Accepted deferral of physical mask labels and complete landing/helplessness interpretations. Local collision priority, current-frame operands, and numeric destinations are supported; they do not prove complete cliff false-return effects, all ground/air setup effects, or the preservation semantics of numeric flags. Verified registrations narrow inherited table-only uncertainty, but do not resolve those broader clauses. Accepted tracking-related deferrals while retaining the concrete producer/consumer behavior. Physics callbacks overwrite x2240 with a zero vector or guarded joint-query output from entity index 1; the string consumer uses the cache when x or y is nonzero. The registered SpecialHi_0–SpecialHi_5 interval contains six entries, including null callback suites, so cardinality does not establish six equivalent cooperative motions. Anatomical, world-space, accessor identity, and full gameplay interpretations remain deferred.

Accepted attribute-range and relative-launch deferrals. Division by x84/x88 alone does not prove attenuation, assigning xA4 does not prove positive vertical velocity, and partner-relative offset normalization does not guarantee an upward launch. The conditional ground/jump setup and subsequent callback installation are supported, but complete conversion effects and a global sole-call-path assertion are not established.

Fighter-side clearing resets x2238 and callbacks but does not itself destroy the article or explicitly clear heldItemSpec. Aggregate interruption cleanup invokes guarded removal, and item cleanup notifies the owner, clears references, and unlinks links. This cross-file evidence supports the document without proving every removal path or the public visible-rope narrative.
